name: hashline-opencode-plugin
description: Hashline plugin for OpenCode — thin wrapper that shells out to the hashline binary

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/v2.ts --outdir dist --format esm --sourcemap=linked --target=bun
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/hread.ts src/cli/hedit.ts --outdir dist/cli --format esm --target=bun
scripts.build:all: rm -rf dist && bun run build && bun run build:cli && bun run build:types
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build:all && bun run typecheck && bun test src/tests/
